definitions.gloss: crocodile tears, fake tears, false tears
definitions.explanation: Tears that are not genuine but shed for show, to manipulate others or feign emotion. The prefix {空|そら} means "fake" or "pretended."

examples.japanese: あれは{空涙|そらなみだ}だよ。
{彼女|かのじょ}は{空涙|そらなみだ}を{流|なが}して{同情|どうじょう}を{引|ひ}こうとした。
examples.english: She shed fake tears trying to get sympathy.

examples.japanese: {空涙|そらなみだ}だと{分|わ}かっていても、{泣|な}かれると{断|ことわ}れない。
examples.english: Even knowing they are fake tears, I can't refuse when someone cries.

notes:
USAGE:
The {空|そら}~ prefix means "fake" or "pretended" and appears in other words like {空返事|そらへんじ} (half-hearted reply) and {空惚|そらとぼ}ける (to play dumb). {空涙|そらなみだ} implies deliberate deception.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {空涙|そらなみだ}を{流|なが}す (to shed fake tears)
- {空涙|そらなみだ}を{使|つか}う (to use fake tears)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {嘘泣|うそな}き: fake crying — similar meaning, more colloquial
- {空涙|そらなみだ}: fake tears — slightly more literary
